finding.text: The task folder has no outcome: `session.jsonl` holds only the `assign` and a `commit` line, so it never records ask 3 (did the `heard` check at `Servex/agents/Sessions.js` ~:1605-1660 show a split, and was anything fixed), the one-line V1Bubbles/ChatV2 answer from "Not now", the test numbers or the `smoke.mjs` result. A fresh agent can't tell from this folder whether asks 3 and "Not now" were done.

`Servex/agents/ChatWriter.js:22-29` `move_line` moves the whole Prompt, every sentence in it, after the last message. So a new-topic placement on the last sentence of a several-sentence Prompt also carries the earlier sentences along. When the Prompt's Reply has already landed, the list goes from [P, R] to [R, P], and any view that draws in list order (V1.2 reads `session.messages` in order) shows the answer above the question. Either target the sentence (or refuse when the Prompt holds other sentences), or stop the move before that Prompt's own Replies, and add a test for each case.

`public/framework/ext/Chat/v3/readme.md:38-39` is out of date: it still says `ChatV3.test.mjs` has "23 checks" and doesn't list section 9's move and improve checks. The new `fixture/move-session.jsonl` is listed nowhere in that readme. Line 304's new bullet names the tests, but the Tests list itself was not updated.

`public/framework/ext/Chat/v3/ChatV3.js:157-163` `relocate` skips a root that has no drawn node. A Prompt moved from outside the newest-40 window to the end therefore stays hidden until reload, even though it is now the newest card.
`Servex/agents/ChatWriter.move.test.mjs:59`: the first assertion can't fail, because the key list is compared with itself reordered. Replace it with `assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(mv), ["messages"])`.
The new test passes in the worktree: `node Servex/agents/ChatWriter.move.test.mjs` printed 5 checks passed. I did not run `ChatV3.test.mjs` (Playwright) or smoke.
Simpler: `placement.moved_id` (`placement.js:9-10`) is a one-line wrapper around `line?.move?.id`. ChatV3 could read that inline, so placement.js needs no new export.
